title: Rotate Array
summary: Rotate an array to the right by k places, in place.

tests.explain: The last three values 5, 6, 7 move to the front, giving [5, 6, 7, 1, 2, 3, 4].
Rotating by 2 moves 3 and 99 to the front.
5 steps on a 2-element array is the same as 1 step (5 % 2), which swaps the two values.

hints: Rotating right by k moves the last k elements to the front. If k is larger than the length, rotating a full lap changes nothing, so reduce k first.
Copying into a second array is easy but uses O(n) extra space. Try reversing parts of the array instead: what happens to the order of the two blocks when you reverse the whole thing?
Reverse the entire array, then reverse the first k elements, then reverse the remaining n - k elements. Use two pointers swapping toward each other for each reversal, and take k = k % n first.

complexity.time: O(n): every element is swapped a constant number of times
